text: Authentic flavors and generous portions — this place serves the best regional cuisine I have tasted outside of a home kitchen.
Typical tourist trap near the main square. Mediocre food at inflated prices and the waiter seemed annoyed we were there.
Romantic candlelit setting and exceptional pasta. The wine list is thoughtfully curated — perfect for a special evening.
The food was decent but the portions were small for the price. Nice atmosphere though and the staff were polite.
Waited 45 minutes for a starter that arrived cold. The manager was unapologetic when we raised the issue.
A hidden gem in a side street away from the tourist crowds. The daily specials are outstanding and prices are very fair.
Lively casual spot with a great selection of vegetarian dishes. The noise level makes conversation challenging but the food compensates.
Generous portions and authentic home-style cooking. This is exactly the kind of neighbourhood restaurant every city needs more of.
The menu promises a lot but the execution was underwhelming. Overpriced for what is essentially average food in a trendy space.
Absolute perfection from start to finish. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavour. We are already planning our return.
Great value lunch spot popular with locals. The daily set menu is always fresh and the staff make you feel at home.
Noisy and cramped on a Friday night but the tacos were genuinely good. Arrive early to beat the queues.
Clearly aimed at tourists who do not know better. Frozen ingredients, slow service, and eye-watering prices.
Excellent vegetarian-friendly menu with creative dishes that even my meat-eating companions raved about.
Good portions and a warm atmosphere. The seafood platter was fresh and well-priced. A reliable neighbourhood choice.
The tasting menu was an adventure — seven courses of bold and inventive cooking. Not cheap but absolutely worth it for a special occasion.
Small portions at big prices. The ambiance is stylish but the kitchen does not back it up. Left still hungry.
Lively neighbourhood trattoria with genuine pasta made in-house. Noisy in the best possible way — full of locals having a great time.
Solid brunch spot with good coffee. Service was a touch slow but the avocado toast and eggs benedict were well done.
Outstanding hidden gem with a menu that changes weekly. The chef sources everything locally and it shows in every bite.
